input.text: 1. Build and calibrate a fixed multi-stage matched quality fixture and infrastructure preflight. 2. Publish protocol, prompts, scoring and interruption/concurrency schedule before scored execution. 3. Run all scheduled independent arms without result-dependent retries or coaching; preserve stage snapshots, model outputs and failures. 4. Independently replay held-out quality/intent/completion scoring and report project-level outcomes, regressions, overlaps and cost. 5. Publish honest README/report/raw evidence, verify CI, and capture actionable product limitations in DIP.
